text:
Predicates:
Composer(x) ::: x is a composer.
Writes(x, y) ::: x writes music y.
MusicPiece(y) ::: y is a music piece.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
Premiered(y, z) ::: y was premiered by z.
Orchestra(z) ::: z is an orchestra.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conducts(x, y) ::: x conducts y.
Premises:
MusicPiece(symphonyNo9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
Composer(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
Writes(beethoven, symphonyNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Premiered(symphonyNo9, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(z) → ∃x (Conducts(x, z)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
Composer(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
